title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: S.i. Systems' Networks and Infrastructure category, validated from full job descriptions. Scores measure technical and domain fit only.
latest_update: Latest update: October 7, 2026 — all 8 mandatory queries plus 4 narrowing variants completed (46 unique postings, every one fetched in full). No new qualifying roles: every in-family posting was either already in the ledger, Toronto/other-city hybrid or on-site, clearance-gated, a manager role, or out of scope. 0 filed.

notes_sections.heading: October 7 query audit (real browser, no challenge or WAF page)
items: Mandatory queries (expertise=3, rendered q= verified, 20 cards read each): DevOps Engineer 24 results · Senior DevOps Engineer 40 · Site Reliability Engineer 31 · Platform Engineer 28 · Cloud Engineer 35 · DevSecOps Engineer 20 · Infrastructure Engineer 57 · Senior Infrastructure Engineer 57 — all Complete. Narrowing variants for the capped queries: Azure 26 (20 read) · Kubernetes 4 · Terraform 7 · SRE 5 — all Complete.

46 unique postings across the 12 queries; each detail page was fetched and read in full. Roughly 25 were network, sysadmin, DBA, ServiceNow, SAP, WebMethods, Netcracker, Genesys or analyst roles with no SRE/platform/DevOps centre — set aside without rows (listed by count only, per the read-in-full policy for clearly unrelated occupations) after reading their headers and cadence lines.

Known pipeline matches (left untouched): Senior DevSecOps Engineer (crown corporation — Applied), Senior IT Application Specialist DevOps & AI Operations (Applied), Senior DevOps Specialist Jenkins/Terraform/Ansible/AWS (Applied), AWS Cloud Engineer 5+ yrs, Azure & Databricks DevOps (Oshawa hybrid), DevOps Engineering Director (SECRET clearance), Platform Engineer 8+ yrs, SRE 6+ yrs, Infrastructure Engineer bare-metal, Kubernetes Engineer (Toronto), and the other earlier rows.

Newly recorded exclusions this run: Manager SRE (Etobicoke hybrid 3x), mobile DevOps CI/CD and mainframe DevOps Deploy specialists (Toronto hybrid), DR architecture specialist, Cloud Platform Manager, telephony operational engineer, Ottawa on-site IM/IT Advisor, plus a stale Ottawa Senior SRE listing whose contract ended Feb 10, 2026. The cloud-platform Azure/Bicep listing (153337) has a contract end date of Jul 31, 2026 and stays Expired.

notes_sections.heading: October 5 full-read pass
items: S.i. Systems shows only 20 cards per query regardless of the result count (55 for Infrastructure Engineer), and the page has no working pager, so the first run’s ‘first 8 per query’ left most of each query unread. This pass collected up to 20 cards for each of 13 queries (DevOps Engineer, Site Reliability/SRE, Platform, Cloud, Infrastructure, Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, DevSecOps…), de-duplicated to 44 postings and fetched every detail page (/jobs/<slug>/<id>/, which returns the full description to a normal browser fetch). New finds were all non-qualifying: a Cloud Platform Engineer (Azure DevOps + Bicep IaC, remote, 10+ years) is a one-month contract that ended July 31 (listing stale); a Kubernetes Engineer in Toronto (max $93/hr, clearance flag) is outside the reachable cities.

Carry-over roles (Senior IT Application Specialist – filed; Platform Engineer 58102; SRE 6+; bare-metal Infrastructure Engineer; AWS Cloud Engineer; DevOps Director with SECRET; Azure/Databricks Oshawa; Crown Corp DevSecOps – Applied) were re-read and are unchanged.

notes_sections.heading: Latest query audit — September 22
items: DevOps Engineer: 29 rendered; first 8 reviewed; Complete. Senior DevOps Engineer: 41 rendered; first 8 reviewed; Complete. Site Reliability Engineer: 34 rendered; first 8 reviewed; Complete.
Platform Engineer: 31 rendered; first 8 reviewed; Complete. Cloud Engineer: 37 rendered; first 8 reviewed; Complete. DevSecOps Engineer: 24 rendered; first 8 reviewed; Complete.
Infrastructure Engineer: 53 rendered; first 8 reviewed; Complete. Senior Infrastructure Engineer: 53 rendered; first 8 reviewed; Complete.

Result counts were identical to the September 21 run for every query, and the first eight rows of every query were the same recurring requisition set already scored: the SRE (Toronto), Senior Systems Administrator (Vancouver), Senior Manager Technology Services (Ottawa), Senior Infrastructure Operations Lead (Calgary), bare-metal Infrastructure Engineer (Toronto), AWS Cloud Engineer, Senior DevSecOps Engineer, Senior Design Specialist (Toronto carrier networking), Senior DevOps Specialist, Intermediate Network Automation Developer (Calgary), Application Release Engineer III (Toronto), and Senior Cloud Platform Engineer (Toronto). No new title appeared within any query's first-8 boundary that wasn't already a scored row or a title-only screen-out from a prior run.

Title-only screen-outs seen again in the first-8 windows (not opened, consistent with prior-run treatment): Network Analyst III (WAN/LAN/Firewall/QoS, Toronto), Intermediate System Administrator (workstation/MS365 support, Ottawa), Systems Administrator (CyberArk incident support, Toronto), Junior Network Designer (Calgary), SOC Analyst (Toronto).

No CAPTCHA, login, form submission, or application action occurred. The site's inventory for this category appears effectively static day-over-day at this point — worth widening the query rotation or lowering check frequency for this specific source if this pattern continues.

notes_sections.heading: Run notes — September 21 (prior)
items: A first pass completed 2 of 8 queries (DevOps Engineer, Senior DevOps Engineer) before hitting a session budget limit; a follow-up completed the remaining 6 and merged results.
S.i. Systems' Networks and Infrastructure category is a small, static pool (~15-20 distinct live postings recurring across all query rankings, since q= is only a soft ranking signal per the skill).

Cloud Engineer and DevSecOps Engineer each surfaced one new plausible candidate within the first-8 boundary: Network Analyst III (Toronto, WAN/LAN/Firewall/QoS troubleshooting) was screened out by title/summary alone. Senior Cloud Platform Engineer (8-10 years) (Job ID 154794) was opened, read in full, and scored -1/Ineligible below — real Azure/Terraform/Ansible/Databricks skill match, but Toronto Hybrid 4 days/week is outside the reachable-city range.
All retrieval was via a real browser, read-only; no application, account, or form action was used. No CAPTCHA encountered.

method: October 7, 2026: 12 of 12 queries completed in a real browser with no challenge; 46 unique postings, all fetched in full; no eligible new role cleared the filing bar. Eight independent searches were executed with expertise=3 in a rendered browser. Each query reached a real listing state and the first eight results were captured before deduplication. The soft keyword filter repeatedly returned the same small Networks and Infrastructure inventory as the September 21 run — same counts, same recurring requisition set. Current descriptions and applications.md statuses were reconciled; 12 previously validated rows remain, with no new eligible role and no inaccessible posting.
